Commentary.Commentary: Kinchit Shah is down for an interview. He says he has been working really hard with the coaches on his technique and it has helped him. He feels they are a few runs short but they can still defend it. Reckons Rankin bowled the best lengths out of the bowlers, not too short and not very full and that is what he advises his bowlers to bowl.

As for the Irish bowlers, Boyd Rankin stood out as he bowled consistent lines and lengths. Although he did not take any wickets he gave away just 18 runs in his 4 overs. Mark Adair also bowled excellently as he conceded just 22 runs in his 4 overs as well as taking 2 wickets. Stuart Thompson and David Delany were taken to the cleaners by Kinchit Shah but the Ireland team will be happy with their overall bowling performance.

The innings started in a very good manner for the Irish as they picked up two early wickets and sent the Hong Kong openers packing inside the first four overs. However, after that, the star of the innings, Kinchit Shah stepped up as he took the attack to the opposition. He played a blistering knock of 79 runs off 54 balls and almost single-handedly has taken Hong Kong to a competitive total. All the other Hong Kong batters around him struggled and none of them even crossed the 20-run mark. They must be thinking that they are 10-20 runs short off the par score on this ground as scoring runs on this pitch is very easy.
So, Hong Kong have set a target of 154 runs for the Irish to chase down and one must say that Ireland right now are on top.
A bye to end a brilliant last over. McKechnie tries to be innovative as he looks to bring out the reverse sweep. Misses. The batters steal a bye. HONG KONG END WITH 153/5!

A couple so still no boundary in the last over. A dipping slower one on middle, it ends up being a low full toss. McKechnie works it through mid-wicket. They take one and go for the second. The throw from the deep is a wild one so the two is made easier.
Continues bowling the slower balls. This is outside off, Singh slashes, it goes towards the sweeper on the off side for one. Top class over so far by Adair.

Two! However, it could have been a run out. One more slower one outside off, Singh guides it past short third man. They take one and go for the second. They almost clash in the middle but avoid it and the two is completed.
Scott McKechnie is the new man in.

OUT! Haroon holes out! Adair gets another. His slower balls have been extremely effective till now. He bowls another one. Arshad swings hard but hits it flat and straight to the man at long off. Kevin O'Brien takes a few steps ahead and hangs on. A run and a wicket to begin the last over.
A single to begin the last over! A slower one and it is on the shorter side. The batter pulls it towards mid-wicket. They take one, they think of a second but then opt against it.
Mark Adair to bowl the last over.
Singh plays the pull shot. The batters pick up a single.
FOUR! Short ball on middle and leg, Singh looks to pull and top edges this one. It goes over the keeper's head for a boundary into the fine leg fence.
Arshad tries to slog this length ball towards the leg side but it goes off the bottom half towards long on. The batters take one.
On the pads of Singh, he flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Singh comes down the track and pushes this one towards cover as he takes a couple.
Wide! Down the leg side, Singh tries to help it fine towards the leg side but misses. Wide signalled.
Full ball on off, Arshad pushes this one towards long off for a single.
David Delany to bowl the penultimate over!
Outside off, pushed towards covers for a single. Good over by Rankin.
Full on middle and leg, pushed towards mid on for a single.

Arshad tries to make room and pull this one over the leg side fence but he gets a top edge on that one. The ball goes uppishly towards fine leg but falls in no man's land. Gary Wilson runs after it and gathers it as the batters take one.
Wide! Down the leg side, Haroon goes after it but misses. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Good bowling by Boyd! Slower short delivery on middle and leg, Arshad is deceived by the mix up in pace and he misses his pull shot as he sways away at the last moment.
Length ball outside off, Singh pulls this one towards square leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, Singh looks to pull but misses.
Boyd Rankin is back into the attack.

A huge mistake by Wilson! That was an easy opportunity of a run out. A lucky escape for Haroon. A slower one on middle, Haroon works it with soft hands through mid-wicket. They take one and go for the second which is a risky run. The fielder gets to the ball quickly and fires it flat to the keeper who collects it, he was standing a little too ahead of the stumps. He looks to whip the bails off but misses completely. Still a very good over for Ireland. 6 runs and a important wicket.
Good running! A short one, it is another off pace ball. Haroon is done in by the pace but adjusts well and pulls it gently through mid-wicket. Some good running sees the batters take two.
One more slower one, it sticks in the wicket a little. Haroon check-drives it to covers.
A couple! One more slower one and it is picked early. Haroon lofts it over covers and takes two. The fielder in the deep makes a good stop sliding to his right.
Simandeep Singh, the debutant, is the next man in.

OUT! In the air... and a very good catch by Balbirnie. A superb catch to end a very, very good knock. A key wicket as Shah was set and was really finding the gaps. Timely wicket one can say. Another slower ball by Adair. Shah comes down the track and looks to go big over long on. Does not get the timing right. Andy there runs to his right and takes a good sliding catch.
Excellent delivery to begin! A lovely slower one outside off, Shah is completely deceived. He looks to go over the off side but is early into the stroke. A dot.
Mark Adair is back into the attack!
Two taken again! A good over for Hong Kong. Slightly shorter. Arshad looks to pull it hard but it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for two. 11 from the over.
Just a single this time as this is hit down to long off.
Another two! This is a full toss. Shah is guilty of going too hard at it. He does not time it that well but gets it away from the deep mid-wicket fielder two taken.
A couple now! Fires it full again outside off, Shah powers it to the left of long off this time. The fielder gets there and keeps it to two.
FOUR! Powerful shot! Once again full but closer to the off pole this time, it is a half volley. Shah hits it hard towards long on who runs to his right but has no chance to get to that.
A dot to begin! Full and wide outside off, the batter lets it be thinking it is going to be a wide but not given.
George Dockrell is back!
Another one on the pads, Shah flicks this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. Two runs added to the total.

FOUR! Making full use of the free hit! Bowled down the leg side, Kinchit gets down on one knee and tries to paddle this one. He gets just the top half of his bat on it and the ball rolls towards the fine leg fence.
No ball! Above waist height full toss on the off side, Kinchit pulls this one straight down the ground. The ball goes on the bounce to the man at long on and the batters take two.
Arshad works this one towards the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Good shot by Haroon! Short of a length on middle and leg, Arshad pulls this one towards square leg for a boundary.
Kinchit Shah has played this one uppishly towards the cover region for a single.
Stuart Thompson is back into the attack.
Kinchit Shah has picked it early and slogged it through the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Arshad gets a top edge on that one as he tries to tuck it towards the leg side. The ball goes uppishly towards mid on and the batters take one.
Full ball on off, Kinchit pushes this one towards mid off for a single.
On the pads of Arshad, he flicks this one towards the leg side for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Kinchit Shah gets down on one knee and sweeps this one towards square leg for a single.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
Wide! Down the leg side by Delaney, wide signalled.
Good length ball on the off side, Shah pushes this one towards cover for a single.
Fullish on off, Kinchit pushes this one towards the cover region.
On the pads of Shah, he flicks it towards mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
Haroon Arshad is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Barkat is the latest man to depart but he has helped Hong Kong to a good platform. Delaney bowls this one fuller on off, Barkat looks to hit it over the bowler's head but gets the bottom half of the bat on that one. The ball goes straight to Paul Stirling at mid off who takes an easy catch. Hong Kong are 87/3 but Barkat departs for a measly 9 runs.
David Delany is back into the attack.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. No runs taken.
Kinchit pushes this one straight back towards the bowler. The ball goes past him towards mid off and the batters have taken a couple.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

Barkat this time shuffles to the leg side but then goes towards the leg side for a paddle scoop. He though misses the shot and Gary Wilson fails to collect the ball. The ball rolls towards fine leg for two byes.
Kinchit pushes this one towards mid off for a single.
Barkat works this one towards square leg and takes a single.
George Dockrell is into the attack.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. They have run through for a single.
On the pads of Shah again, he flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
Half ton for Kinchit Shah and what a time to get your first one! On the pads of Shah, he flicks it towards square leg for a couple to get to his half ton.
Bowls a short delivery, Kinchit looks to pull but gets hit on the arm.
Short delivery on middle, Barkat pulls it towards mid on for a run.
On a length on middle, Shah flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
SIX! Maximum! Short of a length ball on off, Shah slog sweeps this one again as the ball flies towards the mid-wicket fence.
Shah looks to sweep this one but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! This time Kinchit Shah connects well and he slog sweeps this one towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
Almost sneaks through! Floated just outside off, it spins back in a touch. Shah looks to slog sweep but misses and the ball misses the off pole by a whisker. Close call!
Kinchit plays this one towards mid-wicket and takes a single to retain the strike.
Bouncer down the leg side, Shah looks to hook this one but gets a top edge on that one. The ball goes uppishly towards fine leg as the batters take two.
Back of a length ball outside off, Shah looks to defend but the ball misses the outside edge.
Wide! Way wide down the leg side, Shah still tries to go after it but does not connect.
On the pads of Barkat, he flicks this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Barkat is beaten as he misses the line of the delivery.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Boyd Rankin is back into the attack.
Shortish outside off, Kinchit looks to cut but misses.
Good fielding! Barkat pushes this off the back foot towards cover-point, the fielder there inside the circle does well as he dives to his right and saves at least a run for his side. Single taken.
Wide! Good take by Wilson! Delany bowls this one down the leg side, Barkat goes after it but misses. Wilson takes it nicely down the leg side. Wide signalled.
Kinchit Shah pushes this one towards the cover region and takes a single.
Floated on off, Kinchit sweeps this one towards backward square leg and takes a couple.
On the pads, Barkat works it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Shortish ball on middle and leg, Shah pulls this one towards square leg and takes a single.
Gareth Delany is back into the attack.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Fullish ball on middle and off, Kinchit lofts this one and just about manages to get this one over the mid off fielder as they take a couple. 50 up for Hong Kong with this shot.
Wide! Down the leg side, Kinchit looks to flick this one but misses.
On the pads, Barkat flicks this one towards square leg and takes a single.

Good and bad fielding at the same time! Weird stuff this! Kinchit Shah pushes this one towards the cover region, Thompson there dives and saves at least a couple of runs for his side. He then has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. There is no one to back up the throw and the ball goes towards deep mid-wicket. The batters take a single.
Bowls a yorker delivery on leg, Shah looks to flick but misses it and gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals and the umpire shakes his head. Probably it was pitching outside leg.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Full and outside off, Kinchit drives it through covers for a boundary.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Length ball on the body, Shah tries to defend this one off the back foot. The ball gets an inside edge on this one and the batters take a quick single.

Length ball outside off, Barkat pushes this one towards point and sets off for a run. Kinchit obliges but it is a very risky run. The fielder there has a shy at the striker's end but he misses. Had he hit, Kinchit was gone for all money.
Barkat looks to defend this one but does so outside the line as the ball moves in, sneaks between the bat and his body and goes to the keeper. Wonderful bowling this!
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Good length ball outside off, Barkat looks to play at it but is beaten. Gary Wilson gathers the ball and puts in a mild appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Boyd Rankin is into the attack now.
SIX! First maximum of the innings! On the pads again, Kinchit just flicks it powerfully in front of square leg for a maximum. Kinchit counter-attacking the Irish here.
FOUR! On the pads, Kinchit flicks it nonchalantly in the gap at mid-wicket for a boundary. Great batting.
Length ball on middle and off, Shah looks to defend and gets a bottom edge on that one.
Length ball on middle and off, pushed towards cover-point.
On the pads of Kinchit Shah, he flicks it towards fine leg and takes a couple.
Good length ball on off, pushed towards the cover region.
David Delany is the new man into the attack.
Length ball outside off, played towards point.
Waqas Barkat is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Aizaz Khan walks back now and both the openers for Hong Kong are in the dugout. Length ball outside off, Aizaz Khan looks to cut it but gets an outside edge on it. The ball carries to skipper Gary Wilson behind the wickets and he takes an easy catch. Ireland stamping their authority over Hong Kong here.
Yorker outside off, Aizaz looks to have a stroke at it but is beaten.
Another shortish delivery, Aizaz pulls this one towards mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Back of a length ball down the leg side, Aizaz pulls this one towards backward square leg and gets another boundary. Ireland getting some confidence here.
FOUR! Good shot by Aizaz! Full ball wide outside off, Khan lofts this one over cover and the ball races to the fence.
Wide! Down the leg side, Aizaz looks to pull this one towards fine leg but misses. Wide signalled.
Stuart Thompson is into the attack now.
Length delivery on off, Aizaz dabs it towards third man for a run.
Full delivery on middle, Aizaz comes down the track and plays it to mid-wicket.
On a length on middle, Shah flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Good length delivery on off, Shah defends it out.
FOUR! First boundary of the match. Nice shot. Full delivery on leg, Shah flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
On a good length on off, Aizaz guides it towards third man for a single.
On the pads of Aizaz, he flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single. Good start for Ireland here.
On the pads of Kinchit, he flicks this one towards the leg side and takes a single.
On the pads of Shah, he sweeps it towards fine leg and takes a couple.
Kinchit Shah is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The star batsman for Hong Kong is out of here and that too off a very disappointing shot. Delany floats this one outside off, Nizakat tries to play this one wide of mid off but plays it straight to the man there. Boyd Rankin takes a dolly and Nizakat Khan will be a very disappointed man as he has literally thrown his wicket away here. The captain had high expectations off him but he has not delivered. Hong Kong get an early blow in their innings.
Good length ball on middle and off, Nizakat defends this one.
Aizaz has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Good length ball on the pads, Khan pushes this one down the ground and takes a single. 4 runs off the first over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Adair bowls again on the pads, Aizaz misses his flick to get hit on the thigh pad.
Near the hips of Nizakat this time, Nizakat tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
On the pads again, Aizaz Khan flicks this one towards mid-wicket and takes a single. Aizaz is off the mark.
We are all set to begin. The Ireland players are out in the middle. Aizaz Khan and Nizakat Khan will open the batting for Hong Kong. Mark Adair will start the proceedings for Ireland.
Hong Kong Playing XI - Aizaz Khan (C), Nizakat Khan, Kinchit Shah, Waqas Barkat, Simandeep Singh, Scott McKechnie (WK), Haroon Arshad, Shahid Wasif, Ehsan Khan, Kyle Christie, Nasrulla Rana.
First ball of the match, it is down the leg side, Nizakat Khan looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads, the ball rolls towards square leg and the batters take a leg bye.
Ireland Playing XI - Gary Wilson (C/WK), Paul Stirling, Andy Balbirnie, Mark Adair, David Delaney, Gareth Delaney, Boyd Rankin, George Dockrell, Kevin O'Brien, Harry Tector, Stuart Thompson.

Pitch Report - The temperature is very high, around 37 degrees. It is a massive ground. There are a lot of gaps, hitting will be a problem as the ground is massive. A beautiful looking batting wicket. Absolutely rock hard surface. Looks a high scoring pitch.

Ireland skipper, Gary Wilson says that they would have wanted to bat first as well. On their form, he says it has been up and down a bit. They won the home tri-series and in Oman they lost one match out of four but still doesn't consider it their best. He says that one loss here and there can happen and does not want that to bother his team.

Hong Kong skipper, Aizaz Khan says that the wicket looks good and that's why they have decided to bat first. They have not played much international T20 cricket in recent months but their domestic cricket will hold them in good stead.
Toss - Aizaz Khan has the coin... heads is the call from Gary Wilson and tails it is. Hong Kong win the toss and they have elected to bat first.
Welcome to the coverage of World T20 qualifier between Hong Kong and Ireland. Ireland are consided to be favourites for this clash but don't be shocked if Hong Kong give them a tough competition.
